meta.title: Arni: corporate identity for industry | Renee
meta.description: Modular brand mark and corporate identity for an industrial company: from facade to stationery in one system.

name: Arni
summary: A calm, distinctive identity for an industrial company, derived from a modular mark.
challenge: The manufacturer needed an identity that works on the facade as well as on the business card.
solution: The mark consists of four interlocking modules. These produced the logo, a pattern system and the complete stationery.
result: Business card, notebook, company folder and facade design are now managed in a single system.
